lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in approximately parallel horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits, with a higher spatial frequency in the mid-flank than the ventral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid-like arrangement of anchor nodes along the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, showing a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light-saturated pixels on the dorsal edge and shadowed pixels on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin, visible in the lower-center frame, displays a high-density distribution of smaller, high-luminance blobs compared to the larger diameter blobs on the primary lateral flank.
